classes.name: CatalogItemService
classes.description: Implementation of ICatalogItemService that handles catalog item operations including creating, editing, deleting, retrieving, and listing catalog items with HTTP requests and data enrichment.

methods.name: CatalogItemService
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies: lookup data services, HTTP service, and logger.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item by sending a POST request with provided data.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Sends a PUT request to update an existing catalog item.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID via HTTP DELETE request.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a single catalog item by ID, enriching it with brand and type names.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items, with associated brand and type details.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves a full list of catalog items, enriched with brand and type names.

search-terms: Enrichment of catalog item with brand/type names
